overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter of dehydrated Kasuri Methi from India. Our leaves are carefully washed, sorted, and processed through controlled temperature dehydration. This meticulous method preserves the characteristic bitter-sweet flavor, distinctive aroma, and vibrant green color. With moisture kept below 8.0 percent, our dried fenugreek leaves ensure reliable quality for industrial food processors.

We manage quality across a six-step process, from farm sourcing to final dispatch. As a dependable bulk supplier, we provide whole leaves and crushed flakes to meet varied manufacturing specifications. We support global food businesses with OEM services, custom packaging, and complete export documentation. Flexible order volumes begin at a low minimum order quantity of 5 kg.
highlights: Bright green appearance with intact aroma
Available in whole leaves or crushed flakes
Free from artificial colors and preservatives
packaging: 25 kg bulk bags and HDPE containers
5 kg to 10 kg food-grade poly bags
Custom retail pouches and jars for private label

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for Kasuri Methi?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating both pilot product formulations and commercial batch processing.

faqs.q: Can you provide samples prior to bulk orders?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to evaluate leaf color, aroma, and cut size.

faqs.q: What packaging options are available for export?
faqs.a: We provide 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5-10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label services?
faqs.a: Yes, we support private labeling, custom flake sizing, and personalized retail packaging formats.

faqs.q: What is the standard order lead time?
faqs.a: Fulfillment typically ranges from 7 to 14 days, supported by comprehensive export documentation assistance.

faqs.q: How is product quality maintained during processing?
faqs.a: We follow a 6-step process including controlled dehydration and multi-stage screening to preserve leaf color and aroma.
